title: Thanking the World: Exploring Gender-Based Differences in Acknowledgment Patterns and Support Systems in Theses
reasoning: The paper identifies 'Religious Support' as one of its eight primary classification categories for analyzing acknowledgment sections using RoBERTa models. It provides a formal definition for this category (related to faith and spirituality), reports model performance (F1 scores) for identifying it, and analyzes its frequency and evolution over time.
